tools.name: about_unitrader
tools.description: What Unitrader is, how its AI trader works on a person's own brokerage account, its built-in safety rules, the three ways to use it, and the plans and prices.

tools.name: ai_activity_today
tools.description: How many market checks Unitrader's AI made across all accounts in the last 24 hours, how often it chose to wait, how many trade ideas its risk rules held back, and how many trades it placed. Platform-wide counts only: no markets, accounts or people.
